answer: Proposal: conserved trust budgets. Only seeds vetted in person by bonded auditors source trust; any falcon proving a rotten vetting takes the auditor's bond. Each seed's stake ≥ its per-epoch budget × lifetime epochs, so buying one costs ≥ all trust it can yield. An account's weight is its share of the one conserved max-flow the ledger routes from seeds through delegation edges; a knoll of sock-puppets thus shares one inflow, one river with n mouths: cluster weight is capped by the min-cut crossing its boundary — n keys earn one stranger's share, never n. Leak: gulled delegators.
